description: This file defines a React component 'SidebarNavigation' for a web application's sidebar navigation menu, including functions for route path normalization, active item determination, and rendering logic with styling and interactivity. It utilizes Next.js-specific hooks like usePathname and components like Link.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Sanitizes and normalizes a URL path, removing trailing slashes except for root.

methods.name: startsWithPathSegment
methods.description: Checks whether 'pathname' starts with 'base', considering route grouping.

methods.name: isNavItemActive
methods.description: Determines if a navigation item should be marked active based on current route and href, supporting special grouping rules.
